response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist software engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and some exposure to MCP tooling in his current role, but he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions. There is no evidence of Python proficiency, RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or deep cloud-native AI system design — all central to this role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior/staff-level software engineering experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshop facilitation, and cross-domain problem solving
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience and only ~4 months of AI-specific work, far short of the 8+ years required
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)
Limited major cloud platform depth (brief AWS CDK mention) versus the role's emphasis on designing AI systems on cloud infrastructure

key_factors.factor: No RAG, vector DB, or multi-agent framework experience
Recent MCP/agentic tooling exposure and strong general engineering seniority
